Name: Pause While Sitting
Author: OceanSmith
Description:
There's so many lovely places in Stardew Valley with great ambience. I wanted to enjoy these places without worrying that I was wasting time. This mod aims to address this by automatically pausing time while the player is sitting.

Works in multiplayer! Currently time will pause if any of the players are sitting. A future version of this mod will have a config option for that.

Source on [url=https://github.com/heyseth/SDVMods/tree/main/heysethSitPause/heysethSitPause]Github[/url]!
